content: Mweivana vango mweivangane, nikhuvasimbeila umwe einongwa einchi ukhuta mulekhe ukhuvomba eimbivi. Einave yuumu avombile eimbivi, tweinave untangiili uvyaleipupanie nu Dada, U-Yesu Ukristi uvyalinuvuyilweli.
Umwene viukhutusaya khu mbivi ncheito ncheene, hange neikhilunga kyoni.
Pivu eili tulumanyile umwene, einave tulonchilolela indagaeilo nchamwene.
Umwene uveita, “Neimanyile Unguluve” vusikhunchikonga indageito ncha mwene, ideesi, nuwayilweli vusimuli mugaati mumwene.
Ula uviikulibata eilimenyu lya mwene, leli umunu uywa aleinulagano. Mu eile tulumanyile ukhuta twulimugaati mumwene.
Umwene uveita itama mugaati mwa Nguluve pwu umwene anogile ukhugeendelela nduvu UYesu angeindaga.
Vagane, sanikhuvasimbila umwene ululagielu ulupya, ulwakuvalwu lwulalula ulwakatale ukhuma ulutanchi. Ululagilo ulutanchi lyulimenyu eilyumwapulike.
Paninie nincho nikhuvasimbile ulupya, yu lweli mwakristi nandyumwe, ulwakuva eihisi yiluta, nulumuli lwa yielweli pulule lumulikha.
Umwene uveita alindumuli hange iekumbipila ulukololwe uywe iva aliemuhisi.
Umwene uvyagaanile ulukhololwe itama mundumu lisikhuli naliemo eilikhumpeinja.
Pivu ula uvikhumbipila ulukhololwe aliemuhisi khange iegenda muhisi; Umwene sakhumanyile ndaku ukhuiluta, pakuvuka ihisi yiedeendile amiho ga mwene.
Nikuvasimbila uumwe, mweivana mwievagani, pakhuva musyekiliwe inongwa ncheinyo munditawa lya mwene.

Nikuvasimbila umwe mwi va daada, pakuva mumanyile uvialekhwale ukhuhuma kuvutengulielo. Nikuvasimbeila umwe, mwievatumwa pakuva umwe mundemile unduungu. neivasimbile umwe, mwie vana mwivadebe, ulwakhuva mumanyile uDaada.

Neivasimbile umwe, mwie vadada, ulwakuva mumanyile umwene uvialeekhwo ukhuma khuvutengulilo. Neivasimbile umwe mweivatuwa, ulwakuva muleivadulufu, nielimenyu iya Nguluve litama mugaati mundyumwe, khange mndemile undougu ula.
Mulakigaanaga ikhelunga paninie ni mbombo inchilinkelunga. Eingave ikhukhigaana ikhilunga ulugano ulwakughaana uDada lusimuli mugaati mumwene.
Pakuva khilakhinu ikhileimukelunga, uvunogwe wa mbeile, uvunogwe wa miho, namatingo agawumi. safihuma kwa Dada. Fihumana neikhelunga.
Ukhilunga nuvunogwe wakyene filuta. ula uvivomba uvunogwe wa Nguluve uywa veitamaga manchuva gooni.

Mwie vana mwievadebe, gwu insekhi gwavumaleilo. Nduvumupulikhe ukhuta uviesikumwidieka Ukristi ikwincha. Nalienolieno avasavikhumwidieka Ukristi vinchile, pivu tulumanye ukhuta ugwu gwunseikhe ugwakhuvusilielo.

Vulatile munjiela nchavo vahumile khulyufwe, ulwakhuva savaale vakhulyufwe. Vakhale vavinchagee vakulyufwe vale vitamaga paninie nufwe. Vavile valutile munjiila nchavo eikyo kyanonisye ukhuta savaale vakhulyufwe.
Ukhuva mbakhiwe imono nvila Umbalanche numwe mweivoni muyiemanyile ilweli.
Sanavasimbe umwe ulwakuva samuyeimanyile eilweeli, ulwakhuva muyiemanyile na ulwakhuva vusikuli uvudesi uwayielweli eila.
Veeni ideesi vie ula uvikilana ukhuta Uyeesu vi Kiliste? umunu uywa vikilana va kiliste, pala upwi kilana kiliste, pala upwi kilana nu Daada nu Mwana.
Asikhuli uvikilana nu Swambe akhavali nu Daada. Yuyooni uvikhumwideekha Uswambe vie alie nu Daada.
Engava ikyumukhapulikhe kheinyo, ukhuhuma pavatnguleilo khitaamaigaati ndyuumwe. pumutamang'a muswambe nu Daada.
Neiyie ndagano eyatu pile ufwe: uwuumiwa sikhu nchooni.
Nivasimbeile aga umwe agavaala valongoonchang'a mumba yagi pakhukongana numwe, imono nchiila.
Inchumwapiliile ukhuhuma khumwene nchiitaama igaati ndyumwe samukhanoog'wag'we umanu yuyooni ukhuva manyisya, mtaamage ig'aati mumwene.
Puleino vaana vang'aane, mtamaage igaati mumwene ukhuta alavaihumila tuvenchaage namakha tuleekhe ukhufwa isooni pamihoo gamweene mukwilincha kwamwene.
Inave mulumanyile ukhuta umwene vemweeni leeli, mlumanyile ukhuta yuyooni aveivoomba mbwayeilweeli aholiwe numwene.
